import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_3.csv"
    ]

    # Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file)
        dfs.append(df)

    # The target schema is only ['TrackID'] (integer)
    # The transformation plan:
    # - Extract the TrackID column from each source DataFrame
    # - Concatenate all TrackID values from all sources
    # - Drop duplicates to get unique TrackIDs
    # - Sort TrackIDs for neatness (optional)
    # - Save to target CSV

    # Extract TrackID columns and concatenate
    trackid_series_list = [df['TrackID'] for df in dfs]
    all_trackids = pd.concat(trackid_series_list, ignore_index=True)

    # Drop duplicates and sort
    unique_trackids = all_trackids.drop_duplicates().sort_values().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Create target DataFrame
    target_df = pd.DataFrame({'TrackID': unique_trackids.astype(int)})

    # Write to target CSV
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
